description: This file defines a custom React hook `useAuth` along with an `AuthProvider` component that manages authentication state using React Context API. It initializes auth state, subscribes to auth state changes, and provides access to auth info through the custom hook.

methods.name: AuthProvider
methods.description: A React component that provides authentication state and updater via Context API to its children.

methods.name: useAuth
methods.description: Custom hook to access current auth state and updater from Context.
